I'm an Assistant Professor in the [School of Neuroscience][1] at Virginia Tech, working in network neuroscience. 

My research is interdisciplinary, at the intersection between neuroscience, network science, and complex systems.
In my lab we are primarily interested in how the brain's anatomical architecture constrains its functional repertoire, as well as how brain networks evolve over time or across individuals in response to factors such as cognitive load, development, aging, or disease. 

But there's a lot more! If you're interested in these lines of research feel free to <a href="mailto:mpuxeddu@vt.edu">reach out</a>!
